news.title: Krishna Capital & Securities Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 600 million in funding
news.body: Krishna Capital & Securities Limited announced a private placement to issue 30,000,000 shares at an issue price of INR 20 per share for gross proceeds of INR 600,000,000 on March 26, 2026. The transaction will include participation from new investors Ashu Jagmalaram Bishnoi 8,000,000 shares, Yagnik Bharatkumar Tank 15,500,000 shares, Rohankumar Hasmukhbhai Desai 3,000,000 shares, Chhayaben Rohankumar Desai Non-Promoter 3,000,000 shares and Rameshbhai shambhubhai Bhalala 500,000 shares. The transaction has been approved by shareholders and is subject to general shareholders to be held on April 25, 2026.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 2 experienced directors. 2 highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Meenu Maheshwari was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2021. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.body: Krishna Capital & Securities Limited, at its board meeting held on February 27, 2026, approved the appointment of Mr. Raj Kishorkumar Gajjar as Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of the Company with effect from 27th February 2026. The Board approved the re-constitution of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Audit Committee, and Stakeholder Relationship Committee with effect from February 27, 2026 revised compositions as per applicable laws. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.10 (vs ₹0.02 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.10 (up from ₹0.02 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.23m (up 43% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹315.0k (up 235% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 26% (up from 11% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 72 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
